exposure: change in b-hCG values between day 0 and day 4
outcome: need for a second dose of methotrexate (MTX)
cohort: The study cohort consisted of 454 women with tubal ectopic pregnancies treated with a single-dose methotrexate regimen between 2013 and 2019.
finding: An increase of 20% in b-hCG between days 0 and 4 predicts the need for a second dose of MTX with 72.4% sensitivity and 87.8% negative predictive value.
